preconditions.description: The total number of files n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of files to be deleted m must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in indices)
preconditions.description: All indices of files to be deleted must be valid and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(filenames) == n and all(len(filename) <= 100 for filename in filenames)
preconditions.description: The number of filenames must equal n and each filename must have a length of at most 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' if not pattern else 'Yes\n' + pattern
postconditions.description: If no valid pattern exists, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by the pattern.

postconditions.expression: all(match(filename, pattern) for filename in filenames_to_delete)
postconditions.description: The pattern must match all filenames that are to be deleted.

postconditions.expression: all(not match(filename, pattern) for filename in filenames if filename not in filenames_to_delete)
postconditions.description: The pattern must not match any filenames that are not to be deleted.
